title: Superintending Research Scientist, Senior Officer, Hindi Officer, and Confidential Secretary
age_limit: Varies by post and category, ranging from 27 to 42 years as on 14/11/2026

important_dates.label: Reference Date for Age and Experience

summary: Oil India Limited invites applications for various positions in Grade A, B, and C, including scientific, engineering, and administrative roles. Candidates must possess relevant educational qualifications and specified years of post-qualification work experience in their respective fields.
eligibility_bullets: Superintending Research Scientist: Ph.D. in Chemistry/Geology/Chemical/Petroleum Engineering with 4 years relevant experience.
Senior Officer (Mechanical): B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering (65% marks).
Senior Officer (Petroleum): Master's in Petroleum Engineering/Technology (60% marks).
Senior Accounts Officer/Internal Auditor: Associate Member of ICAI/ICMAI.
Hindi Officer: Post Graduate in Hindi with 3 years relevant experience.
Confidential Secretary: Graduate with Diploma in Secretarial Practice/Office Management and 2 years experience.
Full-time employment experience is mandatory; part-time, internship, or teaching experience is not considered.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Senior Accounts Officer / Senior Internal Auditor

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official Oil India recruitment portal.
Ensure all educational and experience documents are ready as per the advertisement.
Submit the online application form with required details.
Upload necessary experience certificates, pay slips, and proof of employment as specified in the notice.
